parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    request,
    CASE WHEN request->>'local_operator_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid END AS local_operator_id,
    CASE WHEN request->>'book_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (request->>'book_id')::uuid END AS book_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(request->>'l1a_id', request #>> '{scope,l1a_id}') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (COALESCE(request->>'l1a_id', request #>> '{scope,l1a_id}'))::uuid END AS requested_l1a_id
  FROM input
), selection_rpc AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    n.local_operator_id,
    n.book_id,
    public.rpc_select_l1a_for_production(jsonb_build_object(
      'local_operator_id', n.local_operator_id,
      'book_id', n.book_id,
      'l1a_id', n.requested_l1a_id,
      'idempotency_key', n.request->>'idempotency_key',
      'correlation_id', n.request->>'correlation_id'
    )) AS response
  FROM normalized AS n
  WHERE n.request->>'action' = 'generate'
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    bp.id AS scoped_book_id, bp.title, bp.genre_main, bp.intent_json, bp.forbid_json, bp.stage_code, bp.run_status,
    CASE WHEN n.request->>'action' = 'generate' AND selected.response->>'ok' = 'true'
      THEN (selected.response #>> '{ids,l1a_id}')::uuid ELSE bp.current_l1a_id END AS current_l1a_id,
    selected.response AS selection_response,
    bp.auto_production, bp.token_budget, bp.token_budget_version,
    l.id AS l1a_id, l.l1a_index, l.l1a_name, l.scene_location, l.conflict_background, l.escalation_path, l.stakes,
    l.irreversible_consequence, l.plot_emotion_commit, l.arc_requirement, l.info_reveal_boundary,
    l.role_arc_json, l.participant_chars_json, l.mid_goals, l.world_resistance_refs,
    l.status AS l1a_status, l.confirmation_status AS l1a_confirmation_status,
    l.is_locked AS l1a_is_locked, l.is_formal AS l1a_is_formal
  FROM normalized AS n
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS bp
    ON bp.id = n.book_id AND bp.local_operator_id = n.local_operator_id
  LEFT JOIN selection_rpc AS selected
    ON selected.book_id = bp.id AND selected.local_operator_id = bp.local_operator_id
  LEFT JOIN public.l1a_unit AS l
    ON l.id = CASE WHEN n.request->>'action' = 'generate' AND selected.response->>'ok' = 'true'
      THEN (selected.response #>> '{ids,l1a_id}')::uuid ELSE bp.current_l1a_id END
   AND l.book_id = bp.id AND l.is_valid AND NOT l.is_shadow
), assembled AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'l1a_id', candidate.id,
        'l1a_index', candidate.l1a_index,
        'l1a_name', candidate.l1a_name,
        'status', candidate.status,
        'confirmation_status', candidate.confirmation_status,
        'is_formal', candidate.is_formal,
        'is_locked', candidate.is_locked
      ) ORDER BY candidate.l1a_index, candidate.id)
      FROM public.l1a_unit AS candidate
      WHERE candidate.book_id = s.scoped_book_id
        AND candidate.confirmation_status = 'creator_confirmed'
        AND candidate.is_formal AND candidate.is_locked AND candidate.is_valid AND NOT candidate.is_shadow
        AND (candidate.status = 'finalized' OR (candidate.id = s.current_l1a_id AND candidate.status = 'locked_for_deduction'))
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS available_l1as,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'world_id', ws.id, 'board_type', ws.board_type, 'atom_type', ws.atom_type, 'atom_key', ws.atom_key, 'item_code', ws.atom_key,
        'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb, 'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims,
        'knowledge_boundary_json', ws.knowledge_boundary_json, 'apply_scope_json', ws.apply_scope_json,
        'violate_cost_json', ws.violate_cost_json
      ) ORDER BY ws.atom_key, ws.id)
      FROM public.v_world_assets_for_exec AS ws
      WHERE ws.book_id = s.scoped_book_id AND ws.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS world_state,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'character_id', c.id, 'char_code', c.char_code, 'char_name', c.char_name, 'char_type', c.char_type,
        'five_layers_json', c.five_layers_json, 'knowledge_boundary_json', c.knowledge_boundary_json
      ) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.char_code, c.char_name), c.id)
      FROM public.v_character_active AS c
      WHERE c.book_id = s.scoped_book_id AND c.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS characters,
    CASE WHEN s.scoped_book_id IS NULL THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE COALESCE(
      public.rpc_get_effective_skills(jsonb_build_object(
        'local_operator_id', s.local_operator_id, 'book_id', s.scoped_book_id,
        'genre_main', s.genre_main, 'read_mode', 'effective'
      ))->'skills', '[]'::jsonb
    ) END AS skills,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(
        b.node_code,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'node_code', b.node_code,
          'model_config_id', b.model_config_id,
          'model_config_version', b.model_config_version,
          'prompt_config_id', b.prompt_config_id,
          'prompt_version', b.prompt_version,
          'template_type', b.template_type,
          'temperature', b.temperature,
          'prompt_text', b.prompt_text,
          'prompt_status', b.prompt_status,
          'model_name', b.model_name,
          'provider_base_url', b.provider_base_url,
          'api_key_ref', b.api_key_ref,
          'routing_config_jsonb', b.routing_config_jsonb,
          'parameters_jsonb', b.parameters_jsonb
        )
        ORDER BY b.node_code
      )
      FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
      WHERE b.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
        AND b.node_code IN ('FP005-01', 'FP006-01', 'FP007-01')
        AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
        AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), '{}'::jsonb) AS runtime_bindings
  FROM scoped AS s
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'request', a.request,
  'scope', jsonb_build_object('local_operator_id', a.local_operator_id, 'book_id', a.scoped_book_id, 'l1a_id', a.l1a_id),
  'available_l1as', a.available_l1as,
  'scope_ok', a.scoped_book_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.l1a_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.l1a_status = 'finalized'
    AND a.l1a_confirmation_status = 'creator_confirmed'
    AND a.l1a_is_locked AND a.l1a_is_formal
    AND NULLIF(btrim(a.scene_location), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND a.runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP005-01', 'FP006-01', 'FP007-01'],
  'book', CASE WHEN a.scoped_book_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'book_id', a.scoped_book_id, 'title', a.title, 'genre_main', a.genre_main, 'intent_json', a.intent_json,
    'forbid_json', a.forbid_json, 'stage_code', a.stage_code, 'run_status', a.run_status,
    'current_l1a_id', a.current_l1a_id, 'auto_production', a.auto_production,
    'token_budget', a.token_budget, 'token_budget_version', a.token_budget_version
  ) END,
  'l1a_unit', CASE WHEN a.l1a_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'l1a_id', a.l1a_id, 'l1a_index', a.l1a_index, 'l1a_name', a.l1a_name,
    'scene_location', a.scene_location, 'conflict_background', a.conflict_background, 'escalation_path', a.escalation_path, 'stakes', a.stakes,
    'irreversible_consequence', a.irreversible_consequence, 'plot_emotion_commit', a.plot_emotion_commit,
    'arc_requirement', a.arc_requirement, 'info_reveal_boundary', a.info_reveal_boundary,
    'role_arc_json', a.role_arc_json, 'participant_chars_json', a.participant_chars_json,
    'mid_goals', a.mid_goals, 'world_resistance_refs', a.world_resistance_refs
  ) END,
  'world_state', a.world_state, 'characters', a.characters, 'skills', a.skills,
  'runtime_bindings', a.runtime_bindings,
  'data_debt', (CASE WHEN a.l1a_id IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(a.scene_location), '') IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
    'upstream', 'l1a_unit', 'field', 'scene_location',
    'reason', 'The selected L1A has no persisted scene location.'
  )) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) || CASE
    WHEN a.runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP005-01', 'FP006-01', 'FP007-01'] THEN '[]'::jsonb
    ELSE jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'upstream', 'v_prompt_runtime_binding',
      'field', 'effective_model_and_prompt_binding',
      'reason', 'An active binding is required for every production LLM node.'
    ))
  END,
  'redacted_error', CASE
    WHEN a.scoped_book_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'SCOPE_REJECTED', 'message', 'The selected book is unavailable.')
    WHEN a.request->>'action' = 'generate' AND COALESCE(a.selection_response->>'ok', 'false') <> 'true'
      THEN COALESCE(a.selection_response->'redacted_error', a.selection_response->'error', jsonb_build_object('code', 'L1A_NOT_READY', 'message', 'The selected L1A could not enter production.'))
    WHEN a.l1a_id IS NULL OR a.l1a_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'finalized'
      OR a.l1a_confirmation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'creator_confirmed'
      OR NOT COALESCE(a.l1a_is_locked, false) OR NOT COALESCE(a.l1a_is_formal, false)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'L1A_NOT_READY', 'message', 'A formally confirmed current L1A is required before production can start.')
    WHEN NULLIF(btrim(a.scene_location), '') IS NULL
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'DATA_DEBT', 'message', 'The selected L1A has no persisted scene location.')
    WHEN NOT COALESCE(a.runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP005-01', 'FP006-01', 'FP007-01'], false)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('code', 'CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED', 'message', 'An active model and prompt binding is required before production can start.')
    ELSE NULL
  END
) AS context
FROM assembled AS a;

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ (() => { const context = $json.context || {}; const decision = context.request || {}; const skillCategories = ['章节展开', '题材组合']; const projectSkill = (skill) => ({ skill_id: skill.skill_id, version: skill.version, source_type: skill.source_type, skill_category: skill.skill_category, skill_name: skill.skill_name, skill_description: skill.skill_description, combo_logic: skill.combo_logic, fun_source: skill.fun_source, arc_structure: skill.arc_structure, applicable_scene: skill.applicable_scene, constraint_fields: skill.constraint_fields }); const input = { decision: { l1a_presentation_plan: decision.l1a_presentation_plan, scene_condition_package: decision.scene_condition_package }, l1a_unit: context.l1a_unit, characters: Array.isArray(context.characters) ? context.characters : [], skills: (Array.isArray(context.skills) ? context.skills : []).filter((skill) => skill && skillCategories.includes(skill.skill_category)).map(projectSkill) }; const binding = context.runtime_bindings && context.runtime_bindings['FP007-01']; if (!binding || typeof binding.model_name !== 'string' || !binding.model_name.trim() || typeof binding.provider_base_url !== 'string' || !binding.provider_base_url.trim() || typeof binding.prompt_text !== 'string' || !binding.prompt_text.trim() || typeof binding.api_key_ref !== 'string' || !binding.api_key_ref.trim()) throw new Error('CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED: FP007-01 requires an active runtime binding.'); const content = binding.prompt_text + '
V7 OUTPUT CONTRACT: Return exactly one JSON object with a non-empty chapter_plans array. Each item must include chapter_index, title, target_snapshot_json, chapter_implementation_json, and exception_summary_jsonb. target_snapshot_json MUST contain arrays core_plot_tasks, emotion_goals, hook_tasks, forbid_content, and a non-empty particles_json; forbid_content may be [] only when INPUT contains no explicit L1A prohibited bridge and must never be derived from forbid_lines_active. Include non-empty pov_declaration.pov_char and pov_declaration.switch_rule, plus pov_declaration.pov_boundaries with arrays can_perceive, can_misjudge, and must_ignore. When switch_rule is "无", every lens_order item MUST name exactly pov_char. Every lens_order item MUST identify a participant POV and one sensory channel. A scene constraint or risk is not a resource: never turn it into an undeclared device, facility, capability, protective equipment, or observation channel; concrete resources must be explicitly supported by INPUT.decision.scene_condition_package.scene_affordance and available_resource_codes. Never relabel resource possession, consumption, or use as truth, info, emotion, or hook to bypass resource verification. Every particle MUST include particle_id, content, type, source_field, purpose, and reveal_to; reveal_to MUST be exactly all, reader, or an array of formal character UUIDs, never a translated label such as 全员 or 仅读者; a resource particle MUST also include world_verified=true. exception_summary_jsonb MUST contain arrays deferred_tasks, data_debt, and conflict_deadlocks; any non-empty data_debt blocks persistence. Put particles_json under target_snapshot_json, never only under chapter_implementation_json. chapter_implementation_json MUST contain non-empty execution_steps, lens_order, and dialogue_plan; every execution step must have non-empty core_particles matching target particle_id values exactly once. For EACH chapter plan, the set and count of particle_id values in the chapter target_snapshot_json.particles_json MUST equal the flattened set and count of the same chapter execution_steps.core_particles exactly once; never reference a particle from another chapter and never place a particle in another chapter array. Do not substitute chapter_seq, plot_targets, or a top-level execution_plan for these required fields.' + '
INPUT=' + JSON.stringify(input) + "
STRUCTURAL OUTPUT RULES:
- Output exactly one chapter_plans item for each item in INPUT.decision.l1a_presentation_plan.chapter_division, preserving each chapter_seq as a unique positive chapter_index. Never duplicate a chapter_index or invent an extra chapter.
- Return only the top-level key chapter_plans. Do not emit meta, quality_self_check, commentary, markdown fences, or any other top-level key.
- Keep target_snapshot_json, chapter_implementation_json, and exception_summary_jsonb as sibling fields on each chapter plan. pov_declaration must be an object, not an array.
- Balance every JSON delimiter and quote. Do not leave a field open or move existing fields into a different parent object.
- Particle type is an exact enum: truth, resource, info, emotion, or hook. Never use plot, fact, event, or any alias.
- Every execution step core_particles list must reference each particle_id exactly once across the plan; do not omit or duplicate a particle.
- Every chapter particles_json and its own execution_steps.core_particles must contain the same particle IDs in the same order; do not cross-reference IDs from another chapter. Forbid-content closure: this input has no separately named explicit L1A prohibited-bridge field, so target_snapshot_json.forbid_content MUST be exactly []. Never copy, derive, or paraphrase scene_condition_package.forbid_lines_active or l1a_unit.info_reveal_boundary.must_not_reveal into forbid_content. If a future input provides a separately named explicit prohibited-bridge array, use only its exact values. For EACH chapter, before emitting JSON, count the actual dialogue_plan entries by primary_function and secondary_function. D-01, D-02, and D-03 MUST each occur at least once, and dialogue_coverage MUST contain exactly the resulting count for every D-01 through D-08 key. Repair the chapter plan internally until this per-chapter closure passes."; const body = { model: binding.model_name, messages: [{ role: 'user', content }], temperature: Number(binding.temperature) }; return JSON.stringify(body); })() }}
